params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the file to retrieve

items.docs: Retrieves the binary content of a file stored in Zoho File System (ZFS) using its unique file ID. The file ID is provided as a required query parameter 'id'. If the file exists, the API returns the file's binary data along with appropriate headers indicating the MIME type and content disposition for download. If the file ID does not correspond to any file in ZFS, a 204 No Content response is returned. This endpoint is used to download files that have been previously uploaded to ZFS and associate

params.name: inline
params.description: To upload inline images. Possible value: inline

items.docs: Uploads a file to Zoho File System (ZFS) and returns the file metadata including the file ID which can be used to associate the file with records in Zoho CRM. The file is uploaded using multipart/form-data with a required 'file' field containing the binary data of the file to be uploaded. The response includes the file ID, name, status, and other details. Can upload 10 files in a single request by repeating the 'file' field. Maximum file size is 20 MB.
